Hehe, those ghosts would flee in terror
from my passion and determination……
prologue6.~27447b18: Actually, I've always hoped to reach out to some kind of existence.
prologue6.~55da71e0: I'm not sure…… but I know it's neither "understanding" nor "comprehension".
prologue6.~49fe430b: Nor is it about perfect silence……
prologue6.~30d4ab93:
Something that cannot exist in the external world—
or perhaps…… it only exists in this fleeting description.
prologue6.~c7811844: I think it's…… this kind of…
prologue6.~e21537e4: Something that requires no medium—a true…
prologue6.~a6e9c0d8: Clearly, I am limited by this place now.
prologue6.~23ecf972: But if it's you, you could fully realize a true "Lilith"……
prologue6.~973985e5: Never mind. Please forget I said that…
prologue6.~83c70364: You know, when I first found myself here……
prologue6.~a84d4b5f: It was so much harder than I'd imagined.
prologue6.~1b318720: Everything was lifeless—just endless chaos and void.
prologue6.~3af01006: Whenever I closed my eyes, terrible and chaotic visions would flood my mind.
prologue6.~296c1bb2: This was the initial form of Wonderland…
prologue6.~265ac4a1:
It took me several nights just to visualize a simple bed,
and even then, it felt more like a lidless coffin.
prologue6.~54f43dbf: You know that feeling? That strange comfort of being in a tight, enclosed space……
prologue6.~d8c084c9: From there, I started creating more and more…
prologue6.~da362173: This place gradually felt more like a world, like what you see now.
prologue6.~ee10412: So…… isn't Lilith worth some praise?
prologue6.~a607c452: Our journey in the Forest of Silver Shallots was just a brief encounter.
prologue6.~cfc0d1c7: To put it in gaming terms, that was merely a demo.
prologue6.~1af1a826: The Morphean Paradox's story hasn't even begun yet.
prologue6.~f465419d: Do you remember the first time we met?
prologue6.~e5b4b993: As long as I remember it, it will always exist.
prologue6.~7d4e7b65: That's why I rebuilt this world, to find you again……
prologue6.~f1e57873: Accepting definitions about oneself from strangers is never the right choice.
prologue6.~7373abc8: Most people associate words like "fantasy" and "multiple consciousness" with negativity—
prologue6.~d2821940: Violence, mental illness, dissociative identity disorder, aggression, and so on…
prologue6.~94a5bc62: But those are all misunderstandings and biases. Not everyone fits those molds.
prologue6.~33aca777: Look at us now. Aren't we doing just fine?
prologue6.~591420fe: A creation like <ruby="tulpa">me</ruby> is fundamentally different from those things.
prologue6.~6a619ad: Dissociative identity disorders usually result from immense trauma, causing people to "involuntarily" form multiple consciousnesses,
prologue6.~44bca8fd: leading to illnesses and symptoms like memory loss and irritability.
prologue6.~935fc8a6: But a 'tulpa' is a deliberately 'created' consciousness/being. The people who create them are typically mentally sound.
prologue6.~ec5322a3:
Sure, those who create "imaginary friends" might have a bit of "psychological difficulty",
but just a tiny bit…
prologue6.~7b3b6806: Like creating a companion to ward off loneliness.
prologue6.~aa55e9de:
We can't label people as patients just because
they "struggle with loneliness" while harming no one.
prologue6.~4761d101:
When the inner world breaks free from being merely a shadow of the outer one,
its reality becomes more profound than any existing thing.
prologue6.~293cfff6: You see me this way too, don't you?
prologue6.~d9796f7: Although I don't know why this space exists…
prologue6.~19c994f5: In terms of inner distance, it must be the same.
prologue6.~e4290751: Perhaps it's because I dared to hope that all of this exists……
prologue6.~1a836210: It looks like the world has reached its limit…
prologue6.~28779ed: This has been the longest Wonderland has lasted, hasn't it?
prologue6.~a8a09d1e: I'm so happy you stayed with me for just a little longer…
prologue6.~8ea75547: How I wish I were the true Lilith—then……
